skill.summary: Give your AI agent a 3D VRM avatar body with animations, expressions, voice chat, and lip sync. Use when the user wants a visual avatar, VRM viewer, avatar companion, VTuber-style character, or 3D character they can talk to. Installs a web-based viewer controllable via WebSocket.

latestVersion.changelog: Initial ClawHub release. 3D VRM avatar viewer with 162 animations, expressions, ElevenLabs TTS lip sync, AI chat via OpenClaw, sakura/anime UI theme, touch reactions, emotion bar, background scenes, camera presets.
